---
title: "Data dictionary"
---

The canonical data dictionary lives in the **`ikdds-etl`** package and defines, for
every registry field: the REDCap field code, the UKRR v5.1 mapping, the eMed source
column, type, transform, and validation rules.

> 🚧 **Planned:** this page will be generated automatically from
> `ikdds-etl/inst/dictionary/ikdds_dictionary.yml`. Until that lands, see the
> [ikdds-etl reference](https://ikddsystem.github.io/ikdds-etl/) and the converted
> [REDCap data dictionary](https://github.com/ikddsystem/ikdds-data-management-documentation/blob/main/docs/redcap/NESKDDSSample_DataDictionary_2025-05-14.md).
